duration.details: Until you cast this spell again, take a Safe Rest, or its ability uses are expended

description.baseEffect:
Tier 1 · 1 Action · Shepherd Only.

Summon an Ethereal spirit companion that moves when you do and is immune to harm. It lasts until you cast this spell again, take a Safe Rest, or it uses an ability, not including Attack, a number of times equal to the mana spent summoning it. You can use 1 Action to command it to do one of the following:

  • Attack | Move: 6, Reach: 1, Damage: 1d6. Ignores armor. Damage type can be any from the schools you know.
  • Cure | Move: 6, Reach: 1, Restore: 1d6+WIL HP.

Outside Combat. Your companion is a spirit, so it can pass through most obstacles. It can be up to 12 spaces away before teleporting back to you. Many places are aware of such spells and ward off such spirits.
description.upcastEffect: Upcast: +1 die step (max d12) and +1 ability use. If 5+ mana is spent, 1/turn, you can command the spirit for 0 Actions.
